detailed_description: YouTube Description Generator turns a video title, keyword, audience, call to action, and resource links into a structured description draft. The output includes an intro, learning bullets, links, CTA, and hashtags so creators can prepare repeatable descriptions before editing and publishing in YouTube Studio.
usage_steps: Enter the video title, target keyword, audience, call to action, and one resource link per line.
Review the generated intro, learning bullets, link section, CTA, and hashtags.
Replace generic bullets with the actual sections, timestamps, offers, or resources from the video.
Paste the edited description into YouTube Studio manually and check links before publishing.
usage_examples: Create a repeatable description format for tutorials, product walkthroughs, or educational videos.
Turn a list of resources into a cleaner links section before publishing a video.
Prepare a description draft for a content calendar, then tailor it to the final video.

faqs.question: Is YouTube Description Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. YouTube Description Generator runs free in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does it upload or edit my YouTube video?
faqs.answer: No. It only creates description text. Uploading, editing, and publishing still happen in YouTube Studio.

faqs.question: How are resource links handled?
faqs.answer: Each non-empty line in the links field becomes a bullet in the links and resources section.

faqs.question: What should I review before publishing?
faqs.answer: Check that the description matches the actual video, links are correct, hashtags are relevant, and claims are accurate.
